$comment: GENERATED in two stages: training/tiny_finglish_training/build_gold.py, then scripts/split-gold.ts --write. Re-running the first alone restores the quarantined rows.

contentMismatch.rule: characterErrorRate > 0.9; otherwise the alignment audit's final verdict is misaligned
contentMismatch.fold: ZWNJ and punctuation folded to spaces first — splitWords() from src/metrics.ts, so the threshold is stated in the same terms as the headline word accuracy
contentMismatch.why: The word-delta filter above cannot see a row whose two sides have matching word counts and different content. These rows score 0% for any transliterator. They are moved rather than deleted: they are evidence about the source dataset.

workers.luna: Codex CLI 0.154.0, gpt-5.6-luna, model_reasoning_effort=xhigh, interactive agents in herdr panes

alignmentAudit.judgesSaw: input and expected only; never an engine output
alignmentAudit.rule: quarantine when both families say misaligned; the 14 disagreements were read by the lead session and none was quarantined (gold-0127 aligned; the rest partial)
